text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work. How did the 
examination go?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Japan Cup, she collapsed right 
away... and for a while, she was in and 
out of the hospital for tests.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And during all that time, Still in Love 
had been coming to meet me every single 
time like this.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Well then, regarding your physical 
condition...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are huge fluctuations between when 
she's doing well and poorly, and when 
she's bad, she falls into a comatose 
state. ...There are no abnormalities 
found, but her body is a wreck.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Shall we head back? I can carry your 
luggage for you.
choice_data_list: It's okay, I can carry it myself.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. However, please do not push 
yourself too hard...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since entering the Senior Year, she had 
carried an air of dignified presence about 
her... but now she has returned to the 
modest Umamusume she was before.

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer! Thank goodness you're still 
here. I have something to confirm about 
the long-term hospitalization!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Long-term hospitalization, you 
mean...
choice_data_list:
Sounds like they're doing a full 
examination after the new year.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: After the new year...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Is that so...
choice_data_list: You really don't need to visit me, okay?

You don't have to come visit me in the 
infirmary, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing how kind she is, she might come 
visit every single day while I'm in the 
hospital. That would end up placing a huge 
burden on her.
choice_data_list:
In the meantime, you get some good rest 
too.

In the meantime, make sure you get some 
good rest too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: I'll go talk to them, so wait just a bit.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I won't have to cry anymore...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We slowly make our way back in silence. 
What is Still in Love thinking right 
now...? Her expression gives nothing away.
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, about next year's 
goals...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A crucial three years for an Umamusume 
comes to an end. I want to support her 
continuing athletic career for as long as 
my body holds out."
choice_data_list: What do you want to do, Still?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...The big race just ended not too long 
ago, so...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Right now... I can't think of anything.
choice_data_list: Oh, I guess that's true too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, with all the chaos 
after she collapsed, I never got the 
chance to properly thank and praise her 
for working so hard."
choice_data_list: So, is there anything you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: What I... want to do.
choice_data_list:
Here, just pick something from the list or 
whatever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She mentioned before that she was making a 
'bucket list.' I wonder if there's 
anything on it that I could give to her as 
a present.
choice_data_list:
I'm feeling super energetic today, I could 
go anywhere!

I'm feeling so energetic today, I could go 
anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Anywhere? ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ... If so,

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I want to... see the moon.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...This brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"The place where I first met you... was 
right here."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back then, seeing her run so wildly, like 
a beast—I was captivated by it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And from then until now... She has 
brought me so much joy. Far more joy than 
I could ever repay..."
choice_data_list:
(I really want to do something for her, 
though...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Eep.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "Something cold just hit my... —Ah."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking up—snow had begun to fall gently 
from the sky, flake by flake.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: A white Christmas... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I felt like I saw a 
Santa who looked like a volunteer at the 
hospital. But with all the check-ups and 
tests, it slipped my mind."
choice_data_list: I... I don't have a present or anything—
I... I don't have a present or anything—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It's alright. Even without something like 
that—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ngh.
choice_data_list: Because you... really worked so hard.
You... really did your absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...You'll wait for me, won't you? 
Surely... forever—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...If it's something I want, there's only 
one thing.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Please, give me a place to belong.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Even just a tiny corner of your heart is 
enough. A place where I can belong...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "Listen. ...Please, listen to me."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I simply wish to place my heart with you. 
Even the tiniest fragment is enough—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
So that I may shield her from the light 
disturbing her sleep—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
So that I can protect them from the winds 
that trouble their heart—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: So that even bad dreams can be eaten away—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —I just want a small corner in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "That is... my only wish."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: You're already at the center of my world.
You are already at the center of my world.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah! A-Are you all right...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: It's bad for your health. Let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Just like always. Slowly, taking each 
other's hands—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if the snow will pile up.
choice_data_list:
I wonder... Doesn't look like it'll stick, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's fantastical... and so 
beautiful. It feels like such a waste for 
it to disappear....”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Still in Love looked up at the sky 
while speaking, a scene from an old movie 
overlapped with her silhouette—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Dance?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The movie featured a memorable scene where 
a beautiful young girl danced joyfully 
alone in the snow.
choice_data_list:
Like... wait, that doesn't make any sense, 
does it?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I want to dance. ...Together, with you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will... firmly support you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: As a Christmas memory... Please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Put that way, I couldn't refuse. Still in 
Love's graceful steps and my clumsy ones 
intertwined...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Don't worry, you're doing very 
well.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the wonderful 
memories.
